name: RLS Remediation Preflight Matrix
scope: Analysis of tables and policy areas requiring RLS review
Definition of proposed future policy controls
non_scope: Actual remediation or deployment of RLS policies
Changes to database schemas or application behavior
statement: documentation-only, no migrations, no policy changes

matrix.proposed_future_control: Department scoping where operationally required; organization/tenant scoping
matrix.required_precheck: Table columns available for scoping (e.g., organization_id, department_id)

matrix.proposed_future_control: Service-role-only write paths; read-only for auditors
matrix.test_evidence: Service-role edge function tests; auditor read-only tests

pre_migration_checks: existing data has organization/department ownership values
normal user, manager, auditor, governance admin, super_admin test personas
rollback_strategy: Backup current policies, prepare down migration script, dry-run rollback in staging
stop_go_gates: Stop on test failure or incomplete data. Go when 100% test pass and rollback verified.
future_implementation_sequence: 83F: RLS policy design SQL draft, docs only
83G: local/staging RLS test harness, docs/scripts only
83H: first narrow low-risk RLS migration, only after explicit approval
known_limitations: this does not make the system production-ready
this does not remediate RLS yet
this does not replace manual security review
